name: board
title: Board
description: Kanban columns over use-drag-reorder — content/chrome split (host renders card content only), pointer drag, keyboard move mode + roving focus, lossless per-card Move menu with lock reasons, server-refusable moves, collapsed lanes, Empty-bordered drop targets.

meta.whenToUse: Cross-column card movement — pipelines, kanban, staged workflows — where the host owns ordering and the move can be refused by a server gate.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-list reordering (sortable-list), tabular data (data-list/data-grid), or static column layouts with no movement (plain Cards in a flex row).
